title: Persist manual cash notes and immutable corrections
requirements: Add the next Alembic revision for cash_notes and cash_note_corrections exactly as accepted in docs/database.md, using UUID primary keys and restrictive foreign keys to inquiries and owner_accounts.

A cash note records only a positive RUB amount, kind RECEIPT or REFUND_NOTE, occurred_at, recorded_at, owner_id and note. Preserve original notes; no mutable balance, checkout, payment-provider data or automatic refund behavior is introduced.

Add the composite identity needed to prevent a correction from referencing a note of another inquiry. A correction keeps original note, optional replacement note, reason, recorded_at and owner; original and replacement links are individually unique and cannot refer to the same note.

Add isolated PostgreSQL migration tests under tests/db007 that create a unique disposable database, migrate Alembic head, assert positive amount/currency/kind, cross-inquiry rejection, unique correction links and immutable correction structure, then drop the database in finally. Never mutate the configured source DATABASE_URL.
Do not add HTTP routes, cash-summary queries, owner commands, payment integrations, production configuration or secrets.
acceptance: A clean PostgreSQL database reaches DB-007 head with append-only cash facts and correction linkage needed for the accepted CashSummary model.
The database rejects invalid money facts, a cross-inquiry correction, duplicate original/replacement correction links and self-replacement.
Focused PostgreSQL tests, scope and whitespace checks pass without contacting a payment service.

shared_paths_approval.reason: Accepted database prerequisite for manual payment facts and CRM summaries; the scope deliberately excludes any payment execution or application command.
